criteria_location: Position Statement pp.2-3 (~55 lines): five device/indication paragraphs (TMVR primary MR, TMVR secondary MR, mitral valve-in-valve, tricuspid T-TEER, tricuspid replacement) with bracketed/asterisk footnotes that carry thresholds, then investigational catch-alls. logic.top_level: pathways: five separate indication paragraphs, each device-specific; each ends in an investigational 'all other situations' sentence

k_of_n.quote: Society for Thoracic Surgeons predicted mortality risk of 12% or greater; and/or Logistic EuroSCORE of 20% or greater.

One of the following (documented by 2 cardiovascular specialists, including a cardiac surgeon): Member is not an operable candidate ... OR ... increased surgical risk ... OR ... congenital vascular anomalies OR ... complex intrathoracic surgical history.

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: None as a NOT list; 'experimental or investigational in all other situations' is the exclusion.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Additional prosthesis codes (33419, 0570T) as add-ons; no repeat-procedure criteria.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Society for Thoracic Surgeons predicted mortality risk of 12% or greater; and/or Logistic EuroSCORE of 20% or greater.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'and/or' with semicolon: either or both. Reads as any-of.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Grade 3+ (moderate) or 4+ (severe) MR confirmed by echocardiography or New York Heart Association (NYHA) functional class II, III, or IVa (ambulatory) despite the use of stable maximal doses
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Footnote defines severity with echo grade OR NYHA class: mixes a valve finding with symptom class; unclear whether the second 'or' alternatives are also required to be 'despite GDMT'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Member is not an operable candidate for open surgery; OR Member is an operable candidate but is considered at increased surgical risk for open surgery**; OR Member is considered at increased surgical risk ... due to a history of congenital vascular anomalies OR Member has a complex intrathoracic surgical history.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Third and fourth alternatives overlap the second; the OR lines are inconsistent (first two end with '; OR', third with ' OR').

extraction_hazards: Bullets are either the private-use character U+F0B7 or U+2022 depending on the document (the fusion guideline uses both), never '-' or '*'; nested bullets use other glyphs ('o') or only deeper indentation
Hyperlink navigation bar after the disclaimer is flattened into a 2-3 row text block that looks like headings
Form-feed (\f) page breaks can fall mid-list or immediately before a section heading, so '^HEADING' regexes can miss; no running headers/footers or page numbers to strip
Criteria live in footnotes with bracketed text and asterisks that restart (*, **) and are placed after later paragraphs; * is used for two different footnotes
Bullet glyphs are '•' (U+2022) here instead of U+F0B7
STS cutoff conflict: 12% (TMVR) vs 8% (ViV high risk) vs 3-7 (intermediate tricuspid)
Square-bracketed text inside a footnote (e.g. '[Moderate to severe ... despite]')
interesting_structures: Risk-score thresholds (STS, EuroSCORE) requiring external calculators
Heart-team requirement as a process criterion
Footnote definitions that change what 'severe' means
Five device-specific rulings in one policy

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: Structure is any/all but footnotes must be inlined, risk scores may not be in the chart, and 'heart team' judgments are process facts.
